questions.stem: A 58-year-old woman, 5 years postmenopausal, presents with intermittent vaginal bleeding for 2 months. She reports no hormone replacement therapy use. On per-speculum examination, the cervix and vagina look atrophic. On per-vaginal examination, the uterus appears small and atrophic with no palpable adnexal mass. What is the most likely cause of postmenopausal bleeding?
